meta.description: Near-black on warm white with one sharp accent used sparingly. The interface stays out of the way and the product photography carries the personality.
notes: This file is the single source of truth for colour, type, spacing, radii and shadows across web, Android and iOS. Change a value here first, then propagate.
Colours are named by ROLE, never by appearance. A rebrand changes the value, not every reference.
Values are px strings so tailwind.config.js consumes them untransformed. Android and iOS strip the unit when mirroring.

Archivo Black has exactly ONE weight (400) - 'Black' is the family name, not a weight axis. Requesting 700 makes the browser synthesise a fake bold. If a lighter display face is ever wanted, swap the family to 'Archivo' (variable), do not change the weight.
color.accent is merchandising (Sale, New). color.error is validation (Card declined). They are deliberately different reds so a sale badge and a failure message never look alike.

color.accent was nudged from #E11D48 to #DB1B45 during task 2. The original computed 4.497:1 on the background - failing AA for small text by 0.003, which rounding to 4.50 concealed. The darker value clears AA in every usage, so the token carries no conditional rule.
color.border is 1.20:1 and is DECORATIVE ONLY - borders and dividers, never text.

contrast.reference: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance. AA body text requires 4.5:1, AA large text 3:1, AAA 7:1.
